title: Request ability to hide/show the default wallpapers located under usr/share/wallpapers under wallpaper type image view
line: The Image wallpaper list now has a "Show System Wallpapers" option, so you can see only your own wallpapers.
explanation: The Image wallpaper picker lists every wallpaper it finds, sorted by name, so the ones shipped in /usr/share/wallpapers are mixed in with the user's own (added with Add…, downloaded with Get New…, or placed in ~/.local/share/wallpapers), and the only way to get rid of them was deleting system files. The change adds a checkable "Show System Wallpapers" item to the Images header's overflow menu, stored as a new ShowSystemWallpapers wallpaper setting (default on). The list's sorting model is now a C++ ImageFilterModel in the image wallpaper plugin, replacing the QML KSortFilterProxyModel: when the option is off it filters out every wallpaper the user can't remove (the existing removable role) except the one in use, and it re-filters whenever the option or the wallpaper in use changes.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add an option to hide system wallpapers

The image list mixes the wallpapers installed with the system with the
user's own ones, with no way to see only the latter. Add a "Show System
Wallpapers" option to its menu, which always keeps the one in use.

BUG: 515292

media.caption: Before: the user's Arctic Sky and Beach Sunset sit between Plasma's own wallpapers, with no way to hide them
After: with Show System Wallpapers unchecked, only the user's wallpapers are listed, plus the system one in use (Evening Glow), still selected
After: toggling the option hides and shows the system wallpapers, and every tile redraws correctly each time

review.text: Clean and well-engineered implementation of the wish to hide system wallpapers in the Image wallpaper picker. Replacing the QML KSortFilterProxyModel with a C++ ImageFilterModel cleanly handles filtering on the existing removable role while keeping the currently applied wallpaper, works around QConcatenateTablesProxyModel's columnsInserted ordering, and fixes the GridView currentIndex binding race that caused stale delegates. The UI placement in the Images InlineViewHeader overflow menu, KConfig setting with default true, i18n context, and before/after screenshots and video are all solid and maintainer-ready.
